messages.subject: Quarto in RStudio: Writing Reproducible & Dynamic Research Papers
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is pleased to be offering a 1-day workshop on Quarto in RStudio: Writing Reproducible & Dynamic Research Papers, running Oct 7, by professor Seraphine Maerz. In contemporary academic research, creating reproducible research papers is not just a commendable practice, but a necessary one. This workshop delves into the integration of R, RStudio, and Quarto, showing how Quarto can streamline the research writing process, enhance collaboration, and ensure the reproducibility of results. By the end of the workshop, attendees will be well-equipped to produce dynamic, high-quality research papers that stand up to rigorous academic scrutiny by using Quarto. This will allow participants to automatically create and dynamically update research papers, presentations, websites, and embedded elements such as results, tables, figures, and citations. All of these can be automatically exported in a variety of formats, including MS Word, PDF, HTML, ePub, and more. By integrating Quarto into the research process, entire manuscripts and all of their elements can be updated simply by changing the R code used to manipulate and analyze data, allowing research findings to be not only reproducible, but also extremely easy to revise and update over time -- whether in response to reviewers or as new data are collected.

For anyone wanting a more general introduction to R, we also have a new 4-day workshop Statistics and Data Science using Tidyverse in R with professor Chester Ismay, running October 15, 17, 22, and 24.

Sign up today for to secure your spot in these unique workshops and please feel free to tell your friends and colleagues!


Best wishes
